text:
ANTONIO:
  I'm just as likely to call you that again.
  To spit on you again, and kick you too.
  If you're going to lend this money, don't lend it as if to a friend.
  When did a friend ever charge a friend interest, making dead metal breed more metal?
  No, lend it to your enemy instead.
  Then if he fails to pay, you can enforce the penalty with a clearer conscience.
SHYLOCK:
  Well, look at you, raging away!
  I want to be friends with you, and have your goodwill.
  I'd forget the insults you've smeared me with.
  I'd give you what you need right now, and not take a penny of interest for my money.
  And you won't even listen to me.
  This is a kind offer I'm making.
